contract.intent: Make the SERVE BIND come from the general config class: rules/config/default.json (registry DATA) + src/flow/config.ts (server.host/server.port leaves — env ANN_HOST/ANN_PORT, user-overlay overridable, builtin 127.0.0.1:8787) + src/abilities/llm/config.ts (overlay schema) + the serve handler precedence (--host/--port > the config) + config! set for the new keys + tests.
acceptanceCriteria: ann serve resolves the bind as --host/--port > ANN_HOST/ANN_PORT > user overlay > project registry > builtin, with both the project registry and the overlay proven by tests (incl. per-leaf provenance in ann config)
a bad bind leaf (non-bare host, out-of-range port) is a NAMED config problem and serve fails closed on it — never a silent fall-back, never a clamp
config! set server.host|server.port writes the overlay, and a non-integer port is refused by name
the full suite stays green; ann check/verify stay clean on the live journey; committed with evidence
